import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

    static int computePower(int base, int exp) {
        if (exp == 1) return base;
        int half = computePower(base, exp / 2);
        long val = ((long) half * half) % MOD_CONST;
        if (exp % 2 == 0) {
            return (int) val;
        } else {
            return (int) ((val * base) % MOD_CONST);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(computePower(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(computePower(p, p));
            return;
        }

        int m_count = 1;
        int t = k;
        while (true) {
            m_count++;
            t = (int) (((long) t * k) % p);
            if (t == 1) {
                System.out.println(computePower(p, (p - 1) / m_count));
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}
